welcome.title: New conversation
welcome.placeholder: Send a message, upload files, open a folder, or create a scheduled task...
welcome.modelSwitchNotSupported: Model list will be available after first connection. Send a message to connect and load available models.
welcome.quickActionStar: Like us? Give us a star!
welcome.skillsMarketDesc: Search and activate community Skills on demand. Configure once, available for all agents.

history.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this chat?
history.exportDialogSingleDescription: Export current topic conversation records (JSON + Markdown) and project files into a ZIP package.
history.exportDialogBatchDescription: Export {{count}} selected topics' conversation records (JSON + Markdown) and project files into one ZIP package.
history.exportDialogHint: Folder selection follows the same interaction as changing the project.

historySearch.title: Search conversation content
historySearch.description: Search historical messages by keyword, load more on scroll, and jump to the matched message.

noModelConfigured: No model configured. Please configure in settings.

pathVariants.WORKSPACE_PATH_EDGE_WHITESPACE_UNSUPPORT: The selected workspace path "{{workspacePath}}" contains a folder name that begins or ends with a space or other whitespace character. Rename the affected folder so its name does not begin or end with whitespace, then try again.
pathVariants.WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: The selected project directory "{{workspacePath}}" does not exist, is not a folder, or cannot currently be accessed. Restore it or choose an existing directory, then try again.

agentError.fallbackBody: This request failed, and the specific cause is not yet known. Review the technical details; if the problem persists, send feedback with that information.

blocked_work.title: Some work is still blocked
blocked_work.body: The Agent reported blocked work, so this task could not fully finish. Review the failure notes in the process record, resolve the reported issues, then resend the remaining task.

step_limit.title: This turn reached its execution step limit
step_limit.body: The Agent used all execution steps allowed for this turn before the task finished. Review the existing results, then split the remaining task into smaller steps and resend them.

output_truncated.title: The model response was cut off by its output limit
output_truncated.body: The model response repeatedly reached its output limit before the task finished. Review the existing files and process record, then narrow the task or switch models and resend the remaining work.

unresolved_plan.title: The execution plan still has unfinished work
unresolved_plan.body: The Agent ended its response while the execution plan still had unfinished items. Review the task list and existing results, then ask the Agent to complete or explain the remaining items.

unverified_changes.title: File changes have not been verified
unverified_changes.body: After a file change failed, the Agent did not check the affected files again, so the final result is unconfirmed. Review those files, then ask the Agent to verify the changes and resolve the remaining issues.

running_processes.title: Processes were still running when the response ended
running_processes.body: Processes were still running when the Agent tried to finish, so the task result was not confirmed. Review the output in the process record and existing results, identify any remaining work, then resend the task.

unverified_completion.title: Task completion has not been verified
unverified_completion.body: The Agent did not submit a valid final result, so the app could not confirm that the task finished. Review the existing files and process record, then ask the Agent to verify the results and explain any remaining work.

rejected_control.title: The model used an invalid operation format
rejected_control.body: The model did not submit the required tool call or a valid final response, so the task stopped. Review the existing results, then simplify the remaining request or switch models and retry.

no_progress.title: Repeated operations did not advance the task
no_progress.body: The Agent repeatedly tried to adjust the plan or submit results without advancing the task. Review the process record, clarify the remaining goal or switch models, then resend the task.

execution_guard.title: Execution state validation failed
execution_guard.body: The current execution state did not pass the app's checks, so this turn stopped. Review the existing results and technical details; if the problem repeats after retrying, send feedback.

recovery_guard.title: Task recovery validation failed
recovery_guard.body: The app could not confirm that this task could be safely restored, so this turn stopped. Review the existing files and process record, then start a new conversation with the remaining task.

resolution.retry: Retry later, or send this message again.
resolution.wait_for_current_response: Wait for the current response to finish before sending another message.
resolution.start_new_session: Start a new conversation before continuing.
resolution.reconnect_agent: Restart or reconnect the selected agent, then retry.
resolution.check_agent_login: Log in to the selected agent, or refresh its credentials.
resolution.check_agent_installation: Check the agent installation and local command configuration.
resolution.check_agent_version: Update the agent, or fix the protocol version incompatibility.
resolution.check_local_command: Install the missing command, or confirm it has been added to PATH.
resolution.check_provider_credentials: Check the model provider API key or account credentials in settings.
resolution.check_provider_billing: Check the model provider balance, credits, or quota.
resolution.check_provider_base_url: Check the model provider Base URL, API path, proxy, and API compatibility.
resolution.change_model: Choose a model that is available for the current account and supports this request.
resolution.reduce_context: Reduce the message content, referenced files, or context size, then retry.
resolution.send_feedback: Send feedback with logs so the team can investigate.

AGENT_SESSION_NON_MODEL_CONTRACT_CHANGED.title: Conversation Agent configuration is incompatible
AGENT_SESSION_NON_MODEL_CONTRACT_CHANGED.body: This conversation’s saved agent configuration is incompatible with the current configuration. Confirm a compatible configuration through the conversation’s agent selector, or start a new conversation. Existing records are preserved.

INTERRUPTED_BY_RESTART.title: Task interrupted by app exit
INTERRUPTED_BY_RESTART.body: The app exited while this task was still running, so it could not finish. The conversation is available again — resend the request to retry.

OUTPUT_TRUNCATED.title: The model reached its output limit
OUTPUT_TRUNCATED.body: This response reached its output limit before the task finished. Review the existing files and process record, then narrow the task and resend the remaining work.

TURN_REQUESTS_EXHAUSTED.title: The turn used all of its model requests
TURN_REQUESTS_EXHAUSTED.body: The Agent used all model requests allowed for this turn before the task finished. Review the existing files and process record, then resend the remaining task.

PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.title: No model available
PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.body: No usable model provider is configured. Add and enable one in Models & Agent, then retry.

NOMIFUN_STREAM_BROKEN.title: Response interrupted
NOMIFUN_STREAM_BROKEN.body: The app accepted your message but the response stream ended unexpectedly. Please retry; if it happens again, send feedback.

NOMIFUN_STATE_INCONSISTENT.title: Conversation state is out of sync
NOMIFUN_STATE_INCONSISTENT.body: The conversation state is out of sync. Restart this chat or reload the app before retrying.

NOMIFUN_SESSION_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED.title: Session configuration changed
NOMIFUN_SESSION_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED.body: The app's current tool configuration differs from this session, so further execution was blocked. Start a new conversation to continue. Earlier completed results were kept.

NOMIFUN_AGENT_SESSION_INCONSISTENT.title: Agent session could not be restored
NOMIFUN_AGENT_SESSION_INCONSISTENT.body: The app rejected an unverified completion, but could not safely restore the saved Agent session. Start a new conversation before continuing.

NOMIFUN_PERMISSION_ERROR.title: Could not access the requested resource
NOMIFUN_PERMISSION_ERROR.body: A local permission or filesystem check failed. Check the project path and app permissions, then retry.

NOMIFUN_INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Request failed in the app
NOMIFUN_INTERNAL_ERROR.body: The request failed while the app was processing it. Please retry once; if it repeats, send feedback.

NOMIFUN_TASK_INCOMPLETE.title: Task completion is unconfirmed
NOMIFUN_TASK_INCOMPLETE.body: This turn stopped, but the app could not confirm that the entire task finished. Review the existing files and process record, then resend the items that still need completion or verification.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_TOOL_CALL.title: Invalid model tool call
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_TOOL_CALL.body: The model returned a tool request as ordinary text, so that call was not executed. Change model to continue; earlier file changes are preserved.

NOMIFUN_TOOL_RESULT_ENCODING_ERROR.title: Nomi could not encode a tool result
NOMIFUN_TOOL_RESULT_ENCODING_ERROR.body: A tool result conflicted with the selected model's function-response format. Retrying the same message will not resolve it; please send feedback.

NOMIFUN_CONVERSATION_BUSY.title: Conversation is busy
NOMIFUN_CONVERSATION_BUSY.body: Another response is still running. Wait for it to finish before sending a new message.

USER_AGENT_NOT_INSTALLED.title: The selected agent is not installed
USER_AGENT_NOT_INSTALLED.body: Install the CLI or app required by this agent, then reconnect it in settings.

USER_AGENT_STARTUP_FAILED.title: The selected agent failed to start
USER_AGENT_STARTUP_FAILED.body: The agent process exited before it was ready. Check its installation, login status, and local command configuration.

USER_AGENT_DISCONNECTED.title: The selected agent disconnected
USER_AGENT_DISCONNECTED.body: The agent connection closed while handling this message. Restart or reconnect the agent, then retry.

USER_AGENT_AUTH_REQUIRED.title: The selected agent needs authentication
USER_AGENT_AUTH_REQUIRED.body: Log in to the selected agent or refresh its credentials, then send the message again.

USER_AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.title: The agent session was lost
USER_AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.body: The agent no longer recognizes this session. Start a new chat or reconnect the agent.

USER_AGENT_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD.title: The selected agent does not support this action
USER_AGENT_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD.body: This agent cannot handle the requested operation. Try another agent or update the current one.

USER_AGENT_INVALID_PARAMS.title: The selected agent rejected the request
USER_AGENT_INVALID_PARAMS.body: The agent reported that the request format was invalid. Try simplifying the message or switching agents.

USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_FAILED.title: Agent handshake failed
USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_FAILED.body: The selected agent could not complete its startup handshake. Restart or reconnect the agent, then retry.

USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT.title: Agent handshake timed out
USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT.body: The selected agent did not finish its startup handshake in time. The first launch may need to download the agent runtime (tens of MB) — check your network/proxy, then retry; retrying resumes cleanly.

USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.title: Agent protocol versions are incompatible
USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.body: The selected agent is using an incompatible protocol version. Update the agent or switch to a compatible one.

USER_AGENT_NO_PREVIOUS_SESSION.title: Previous agent session is unavailable
USER_AGENT_NO_PREVIOUS_SESSION.body: The agent cannot resume the previous session. Start a new conversation to continue.

USER_AGENT_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND.title: Agent command was not found
USER_AGENT_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND.body: The configured agent command could not be found. Install it or update the command path in settings.

USER_AGENT_MISSING_ENV.title: Agent environment is missing required variables
USER_AGENT_MISSING_ENV.body: The agent needs environment variables that are not configured. Add them in settings or your shell environment, then reconnect.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED.title: Model service authentication failed
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED.body: Model service authentication failed, but the exact credential or authentication method issue is unconfirmed. Check the API key provider, expiration, and authentication method, then retry.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONFIG_ERROR.title: Model provider configuration is invalid
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONFIG_ERROR.body: The provider request could not be built from the current settings. Check credentials, region, Base URL, and provider-specific configuration before retrying.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_FOUND.title: The selected model was not found
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_FOUND.body: The provider does not recognize this model name. Choose an available model from settings and retry.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.title: Model provider rate limit reached
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.body: The provider is temporarily limiting requests. Wait a moment, reduce request frequency, or switch models.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.title: Model provider request timed out
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.body: The provider did not respond in time. Retry later or switch to a more stable provider.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR.title: The model service network request failed
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR.body: The model service network request failed, and the specific connection issue is unconfirmed. Check the network, proxy, and endpoint, then review the technical details to identify the cause.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_GATEWAY_ERROR.title: Model provider service is unavailable
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_GATEWAY_ERROR.body: The provider returned a gateway or service error. Retry later or use another provider.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Access to the model service was denied
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Access to the model service was denied, but the specific restriction is unconfirmed. Check account and model permissions, the API address, and proxy or gateway access rules.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_BILLING_REQUIRED.title: Model provider billing is required
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_BILLING_REQUIRED.body: The selected provider needs active billing, credits, or quota before it can complete this request.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.title: Model does not support this request
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.body: The selected model is unavailable or does not support the requested capability. Choose a supported model and retry.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.title: The model service could not find the requested resource
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.body: The model service could not find the requested resource. Check the Base URL, API path and protocol, and deployment or model name, then retry.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_REQUEST.title: Model provider rejected the request
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_REQUEST.body: The provider reported that the request was invalid. Simplify the message or check model/provider settings.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_TOOL_SCHEMA.title: Tool schema was rejected by the provider
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_TOOL_SCHEMA.body: The provider rejected a tool definition in this request. Update the agent or disable the incompatible tool, then retry.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.title: Context is too large for the model
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.body: The request exceeds the model context limit. Reduce message content, referenced files, or conversation history, then retry.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE.title: Model provider returned an empty response
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE.body: The provider completed the request without usable content. Retry once or switch providers if it repeats.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNBACKED_COMPLETION.title: The model did not verify the requested deliverable
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNBACKED_COMPLETION.body: The model reported the task as complete, but no verified evidence matched a required file. Existing completed work was kept. Choose another model before continuing.

WORKSPACE_PATH_EDGE_WHITESPACE_RUNTIME_U.title: This workspace path cannot be used for execution
WORKSPACE_PATH_EDGE_WHITESPACE_RUNTIME_U.body: This conversation or task is bound to a workspace path that contains a directory name beginning or ending with whitespace. Rename the affected directory, or recreate the conversation or task with a valid workspace path.
WORKSPACE_PATH_EDGE_WHITESPACE_RUNTIME_U.bodyWithPath: The workspace path "{{workspacePath}}" contains a directory name that begins or ends with whitespace. Rename the affected directory, or recreate the conversation or task with a valid workspace path.

WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.title: Project directory is unavailable
WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.body: The project directory bound to this conversation or task no longer exists or cannot be accessed. Restore it, or create a new conversation or task with another project.
WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.bodyWithPath: The project directory "{{workspacePath}}" no longer exists or cannot be accessed. Restore it, or create a new conversation or task with another project.

UNKNOWN_UPSTREAM_ERROR.title: The upstream agent or provider failed
UNKNOWN_UPSTREAM_ERROR.body: The app received an upstream error but could not classify it confidently. Review the details below or send feedback.

EXECUTION_MODEL_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.title: The model service is temporarily unavailable
EXECUTION_MODEL_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.body: The model service cannot process requests right now, so this request failed. Review the existing results, then retry later or switch models and resend the remaining task.

EXECUTION_CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED.title: Task resource cleanup is unconfirmed
EXECUTION_CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED.body: Resource cleanup for this turn is unconfirmed, so new messages cannot be sent yet. Wait for the app to confirm cleanup and update its state; if sending remains blocked, review the technical details and send feedback.

EXECUTION_PAUSED.title: Task paused
EXECUTION_PAUSED.body: This turn paused, and completed operations are retained. Review the process record and existing results to identify any remaining work.

EXECUTION_USER_REQUESTED.title: Task paused at your request
EXECUTION_USER_REQUESTED.body: This turn paused at your request. Review the process record and existing results to identify any remaining work.

EXECUTION_ATTACH_FAILED.title: Could not connect the execution environment
EXECUTION_ATTACH_FAILED.body: The app could not connect the execution environment for this turn, so the task paused. Review the existing results and technical details; if it cannot be restored, send feedback.

EXECUTION_PREPARATION_BLOCKED.title: Task preparation did not finish
EXECUTION_PREPARATION_BLOCKED.body: Preparation for this turn did not finish, so the task paused. Review the technical details and resolve the reported issues before retrying.

EXECUTION_SESSION_PAYLOAD_BUDGET.title: Conversation content reached its capacity limit
EXECUTION_SESSION_PAYLOAD_BUDGET.body: This conversation reached its content capacity limit, so the task paused and cannot record more execution results. Review the existing results, then start a new conversation with the remaining task.

EXECUTION_MODEL_STREAM_ENDED_WITHOUT_TER.title: The model response ended unexpectedly
EXECUTION_MODEL_STREAM_ENDED_WITHOUT_TER.body: The model response stream ended before a normal completion, so this request failed. Review the existing results, then retry or switch models and resend the remaining task.

EXECUTION_MODEL_INVALID_EVENT.title: The model returned an invalid response format
EXECUTION_MODEL_INVALID_EVENT.body: The model returned response data that could not be processed, so this request failed. Review the existing results, then retry; if it happens again, switch models or send feedback.

CONVERSATION_SEND_FAILED.title: Message could not be sent
CONVERSATION_SEND_FAILED.body: An error occurred while sending the message, and the specific cause is not yet known. Check whether the message arrived in the conversation before resending it; if the problem persists, review the technical details and send feedback.

CONVERSATION_PREPARATION_FAILED.title: Message preparation failed
CONVERSATION_PREPARATION_FAILED.body: An error occurred while preparing the message, and the specific cause is not yet known. Check the selected Agent, model, and workspace, then retry; if the problem persists, review the technical details and send feedback.

CONVERSATION_CREATION_FAILED.title: Conversation could not be created
CONVERSATION_CREATION_FAILED.body: An error occurred while creating the conversation, and the specific cause is not yet known. Check the conversation list to see whether it was created before trying again; if the problem persists, review the technical details and send feedback.

CONVERSATION_STEER_FAILED.title: Additional instructions could not be submitted
CONVERSATION_STEER_FAILED.body: An error occurred while submitting additional instructions, and the specific cause is not yet known. Check the process record to see whether they arrived before resending them; if the problem persists, review the technical details and send feedback.

CONVERSATION_CONTEXT_CLEAR_FAILED.title: Conversation context could not be cleared
CONVERSATION_CONTEXT_CLEAR_FAILED.body: An error occurred while clearing the conversation context, and the specific cause is not yet known. Reopen the conversation to check its state, then retry; if the problem persists, review the technical details and send feedback.

SESSION_CAPABILITIES_FAILED.title: Conversation capabilities could not be loaded
SESSION_CAPABILITIES_FAILED.body: The available models and capabilities for this conversation could not be loaded. Reopen the conversation and retry; if the problem persists, check the Agent connection and review the technical details.

CONVERSATION_CREATION_STATUS_FAILED.title: Conversation creation status could not be loaded
CONVERSATION_CREATION_STATUS_FAILED.body: The conversation creation status could not be loaded, so its creation result is unconfirmed. Check the conversation list or retry later to avoid creating the same conversation twice.

CONVERSATION_GENERATION_FAILED.title: Generation request failed
CONVERSATION_GENERATION_FAILED.body: An error occurred while processing the generation request, and the specific cause is not yet known. Review the existing results, then retry; if the problem persists, review the technical details and send feedback.

EXECUTION_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.title: The model does not support a required feature
EXECUTION_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.body: The model service does not support a feature required by this request, so this request failed. Remove the unsupported content or switch models, then resend the remaining task.

EXECUTION_MODEL_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.title: The model response violated the protocol
EXECUTION_MODEL_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.body: The model service returned data that did not follow the response protocol, so this request failed. Retry; if it happens again, switch models or send feedback.

EXECUTION_MODEL_STREAM_INTERRUPTED.title: The model response stream was interrupted
EXECUTION_MODEL_STREAM_INTERRUPTED.body: The model response stream was interrupted during execution, so this request failed. Review the existing results, then retry or switch models and resend the remaining task.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED.title: The model does not support image input
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED.body: The current model cannot process the images in this request. Remove the images or choose a model that supports image input, then resend the request.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.title: The model service is temporarily unavailable
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.body: The model service cannot process requests right now, so this request failed. Review the existing files and process record, then retry later or switch models and resend the remaining task.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.title: The model does not support a required feature
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.body: The model service does not support a feature required by this request, so this request failed. Review the existing results, then remove the unsupported content or switch models and resend the remaining task.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE.title: The model returned an invalid response format
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE.body: The model service returned response data that could not be processed, so this request failed. Review the existing results, then retry the remaining task; if it happens again, switch models or send feedback.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_STREAM_INTERRUPTED.title: The model response stream was interrupted
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_STREAM_INTERRUPTED.body: The model response stream was interrupted before the task finished, so this request failed. Review the existing files and process record, then retry or switch models and resend the remaining task.

auth_failed.title: Model service authentication failed
auth_failed.body: Model service authentication failed, but the exact credential or authentication method issue is unconfirmed. Check the API key provider, expiration, and authentication method, then retry.

invalid_key.title: The model service credentials are invalid
invalid_key.body: The provider explicitly reported invalid credentials. Check the API key, access token or cloud credentials and their provider, project or region; update them in model settings if needed, then retry.

expired_key.title: Model service credentials have expired
expired_key.body: The provider explicitly reported that the credentials have expired. Refresh them or create a new API key, update model settings, then retry.

insufficient_quota.title: Model service quota is insufficient
insufficient_quota.body: The provider explicitly reported insufficient available quota for this account. Check the quota, billing status, and reset time, then add quota or wait for it to reset before retrying.

insufficient_balance.title: The model service account has insufficient balance
insufficient_balance.body: The provider explicitly reported insufficient account balance. Add credit to the provider account or switch to a provider with available credit, then retry.

subscription_expired.title: The model service subscription has expired
subscription_expired.body: The provider explicitly reported that the account subscription has expired. Renew it or choose a plan and model available to the account, then retry.

model_not_in_plan.title: The selected model is not included in the current plan
model_not_in_plan.body: The provider explicitly reported that the selected model is outside the current plan. Choose a model included in the plan or update the subscription, then retry.

permission_denied.title: Access to the model service was denied
permission_denied.body: Access to the model service was denied, but the specific restriction is unconfirmed. Check account and model permissions, the API address, and proxy or gateway access rules.

model_permission_denied.title: The account cannot access the selected model
model_permission_denied.body: The provider explicitly denied this account access to the selected model. Check account, project, and model permissions, or choose a model available to the account, then retry.

endpoint_missing.title: The model service could not find the requested resource
endpoint_missing.body: The model service could not find the requested resource. Check the Base URL, API path and protocol, and deployment or model name, then retry.

non_api_response.title: The model endpoint returned non-API content
non_api_response.body: The request returned a web page or other content that is not a model API response. Check that the Base URL points to an API endpoint and the protocol matches, and check for proxy or gateway login pages.

auth_scheme_mismatch.title: Authentication method does not match the model API
auth_scheme_mismatch.body: The configured authentication method does not match the model API requirements. Select the method required by the provider API, check the protocol and credentials, then retry.

rate_limited.title: Model service requests are rate limited
rate_limited.body: The provider limited this request, which may involve request rate, concurrency or a periodic allowance. Check the model and organization limits; if a retry delay was returned, wait for that delay before retrying.

dns_failure.title: Could not resolve the model service address
dns_failure.body: DNS resolution failed for the model service address. Check the Base URL hostname, DNS, network, and proxy settings, then retry.

connection_failed.title: Could not connect to the model service
connection_failed.body: A connection to the model service could not be established. Check the endpoint host and port, service availability, and network and proxy settings, then retry.

tls_failure.title: Secure connection to the model service failed
tls_failure.body: The TLS handshake or certificate verification failed for the model service. Check the HTTPS address, certificates, system time, and proxy settings, then retry.

proxy_failure.title: The model request proxy connection failed
proxy_failure.body: The model request could not pass through the configured proxy. Check its address, port, authentication method, and availability, then retry.

request_timeout.title: Model service request timed out
request_timeout.body: A complete model response was not received within the time limit. Check the network and proxy, then retry later or switch providers.

upstream_server_error.title: The model service returned a server error
upstream_server_error.body: The model service or an intermediate gateway returned a server error. Retry later and check the provider status; if it persists, switch providers.

provider_unavailable.title: The model service is currently unavailable
provider_unavailable.body: The model service cannot process the request right now, and the specific cause is unconfirmed. Retry later; if it persists, review the provider status and technical details or switch providers.

network_failure.title: The model service network request failed
network_failure.body: The model service network request failed, and the specific connection issue is unconfirmed. Check the network, proxy, and endpoint, then review the technical details to identify the cause.

stream_interrupted.title: Model response transmission was interrupted
stream_interrupted.body: Transmission of the model response was interrupted before it finished. Check the network and proxy, then retry; if it repeats, switch providers or send feedback.

invalid_response.title: The model response does not match the API protocol
invalid_response.body: The model service returned data that could not be processed with the current API protocol. Check the Base URL, selected protocol, and service compatibility; if the configuration is correct, switch models or send feedback.

invalid_request.title: The model request parameters cannot be used
invalid_request.body: The request parameters cannot be processed as required by the model API. Check the model name, API protocol, generation parameters and referenced content, or simplify the message and retry.

unsupported_feature.title: A feature required by this request is unavailable
unsupported_feature.body: The model service could not handle a feature required by this request. Check model capabilities and the API protocol, then adjust the request or choose a compatible model.

model_not_found.title: Model not found
model_not_found.body: The provider could not find the selected model; its name may be invalid or it may not be visible to this account. Check the model ID, deployment name, and models available to the account, then retry.

content_policy.title: Model service rejected the content
content_policy.body: The provider rejected this request under its content policy. Review the message and referenced content against the provider requirements; if ordinary content was misclassified, send feedback to the provider and include the request ID from technical details if available.

billing_required.title: Model service requires billing
billing_required.body: The model service returned a payment-required response, and the specific billing restriction is unconfirmed. Check the account billing status, plan, and balance, then retry.

prompt_too_long.title: The request context exceeds the model limit
prompt_too_long.body: The provider explicitly rejected the request context length. Reduce the message, referenced files or history, or choose a model with a larger context window.

provider_overloaded.title: The model service is overloaded
provider_overloaded.body: The provider explicitly reported that it is overloaded and could not handle this request. Wait for the indicated delay before retrying, or choose another available provider.

configuration_error.title: The model request configuration cannot be used
configuration_error.body: The app could not prepare or complete the model request with the current configuration. Check the API protocol, endpoint, authentication configuration and required parameters.

invalid_endpoint.title: The model endpoint URL is invalid
